convert_benchmark_json_to_csv: convert google-benchmark JSON output to CSV format for BigQuery upload
print_bigquery_schema: print the BigQuery microbenchmarks table schema using the --schema flag
sanitize_column_values: sanitize row values to match BigQuery SQL types like integer, float, boolean, string, and timestamp
expand_benchmark_json: expand benchmark JSON data using bm_json.expand_json with an optional second JSON file for comparison
fetch_bq_schema: fetch the BigQuery table schema via subprocess call to the bq CLI tool
